conviction_note: A 9M release with new numbers and a sales guide (>EUR 6.5bn) that needs H2 sales +16% over H1 after Q2 sales grew only 2.9%. That makes a guidance line live, so abs_move is 7.0. The provision, arbitration, order-intake and dividend items are mostly public, and the stock ran +20% in 20 sessions into the print. p_up is 46, a slight lean against a reiteration that is already priced. The findings sum (-1.3) and the scaled number (-0.56) agree in sign; neither is fitted to the other.

already_public.what: H1 2026: sales EUR 3,061m (+12%), underlying EBIT EUR 149m (4.9%), Q2 EBIT EUR 73.2m (5.0%), net cash EUR 344m, backlog EUR 13.9bn; 2026 guide sales >EUR 6.5bn, underlying EBIT >EUR 325m, margin >5%; order intake 2026 >EUR 8bn
LOI accepted for a USD 1.65bn onshore gas facilities contract in the Middle East (OIR)

MGT Teesside award (EUR 120m net to the consortium) and lifting of the Bapco Sitra bond interim measures (EUR 133m of bonds): net cash outflow EUR 49m, net P&L impact +EUR 7m, 'does not modify the results guidance for the fiscal year 2026' (OIR)

Chairman interview: no further Middle East provisions in 2026; any 2027 top-up 'significantly lower' than EUR 45m; dividend returns at a 30% payout with a first payment planned for end-2026; TR Power sales >EUR 1.2bn in 2026
Share buy-back programme (Inside Information reg. 3351, 15 Sep 2026); weekly OIR execution reports run to 14 Oct 2026
Q3/Q4 awards press-released: LNG Canada services (19 Oct), Ethiopia hydrogen (28 Oct), Sweden e-SAF engineering (10 Nov), Kazakhstan ammonia PMC (12 Nov)

new_in_release.expect: Sales guide >EUR 6.5bn at risk of a trim or a soft 'around' (needs ~EUR 3.44bn in H2 against EUR 3.06bn in H1). The underlying EBIT >EUR 325m guide is more likely held on margin. Slight lean down.
Q3 underlying EBIT around EUR 80m against the ~EUR 88m/quarter H2 run-rate the guide implies, and against EUR 84.5m in Q3 2025. Unsourced consensus, so unknown and small.
Net cash below the H1 figure of EUR 344m after the EUR 49m Bapco/MGT outflow and the buy-back. Pre-flagged, so small, though the market may read it negatively.
Possible first detail of the end-2026 payment (30% payout). Intent is public; an amount would be mildly positive.
Order intake YTD and backlog at a record (>EUR 15bn per Renta 4), plus any LOI-to-contract conversion. Mostly public.

positioning_check: Register not covered for this market. The CNMV short-position grid is unreadable from this container, so nothing is known about short interest (this is not a zero). priced_lean_pct (-1.0) is the 20-day run-up (+20.0%) itself. The only flow evidence is the issuer's own buy-back, which reported executions through 14 Oct 2026 and has filed no weekly report since.

findings.finding: The 2026 sales guide (>EUR 6.5bn) needs about EUR 3.44bn in H2, +16% over H1's EUR 3.06bn, after Q2 sales grew only 2.9% y/y to EUR 1,478m. Renta 4's own model already sits 5% under the guide (EUR 6,297m), so the 9M release risks a trim or a softened sales guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raised at the Oct 2025 Investor Day: the stock rose 8% to 22% that day (xtb / okdiario). Guidance changes are this name's largest movers; the stock fell 33.9% from 27 Feb to mid-Sep 2026 on the Middle East disruption.
findings.original_quote: nuestro escenario asume una reducción de ventas 2026e un -5% hasta 6.297 mln eur ... las ventas crecieron un +2,9% hasta 1.478 mln eur y el EBIT subyacente un +14% hasta 73,2 mln eur (margen 5,0%)  [our scenario assumes 2026e sales cut 5% to EUR 6,297m ... sales grew 2.9% to EUR 1,478m and underlying EBIT 14% to EUR 73.2m]
findings.why_not_priced: The stock rose 20% in 20 sessions and 7% in 5 to EUR 31.14, the highest since the conflict began. That rally is consistent with a market expecting the guide to be held. A broker model below the guide is public, but the price has moved away from it rather than toward it; if the trim were priced, the run-up would have stalled into the print.
findings.independence: H1 2026 release arithmetic (https://www.tecnicasreunidas.es/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Tecnicas-Reunidas-H1-2026-Results-Release-ENG-FINAL.pdf): H1 EUR 3,061m against a >EUR 6,500m guide. Same base data, not an independent source.

findings.finding: Q3 net cash will carry the pre-flagged EUR 49m net outflow from the Bapco Sitra bond call (EUR 133m, interim measures lifted 17 Sep) net of the MGT Teesside award, plus buy-back spend, so net cash is likely below H1's EUR 344m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction on a cash line for this name. In Europe, Luceco fell 5.5% on free cash flow despite a raised guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The amount was disclosed, so most of it is priced. What is unknown is how working capital on the Middle East projects moved in Q3; the Q2 cash was strong. Sized small because the company itself said guidance is unchanged.
findings.independence: OIR 10 Aug 2026 (https://www.tecnicasreunidas.es/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/OIR_20260810_EN.pdf), the earlier Bapco statement.

findings.finding: Management publicly ruled out further Middle East provisions in 2026 (beyond the EUR 45m booked in Q1) and confirmed a 30% payout dividend with a first payment at end-2026; the 9M release may confirm both and give an amount.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Stock rose about 4.5% across 22 Sep 2026 (EUR 26.46 to 27.64 close) on the day of the interview coverage; no earlier dividend-reinstatement history.
findings.original_quote: Juan Lladó descarta nuevas provisiones por el conflicto de Oriente Medio durante 2026 ... La compañía recuperará el dividendo con un pay-out inicial del 30% y un primer pago previsto para finales de 2026.  [Lladó rules out new Middle East provisions in 2026 ... dividend returns at an initial 30% payout, first payment planned for end-2026]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is public and the stock reacted. The residual is a confirmed amount and date. A fresh provision would be the surprise, but the chairman's statement makes that unlikely inside the window.
findings.independence: H1 2026 release: 'the EUR 45 million provision recognized in the first quarter remains appropriate' (https://www.tecnicasreunidas.es/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Tecnicas-Reunidas-H1-2026-Results-Release-ENG-FINAL.pdf).

findings.finding: Order intake keeps landing after H1 (USD 1.65bn Middle East gas LOI on 13 Aug, LNG Canada, Ethiopia, Sweden e-SAF, Kazakhstan ammonia PMC on 12 Nov), which supports the >EUR 8bn 2026 intake guide and a record backlog (>EUR 15bn per Renta 4).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Large awards have moved the stock up: +14% over five days on Kazakhstan in Sep 2024 (merca2) and a jump on the ADNOC/Exxon packages in June 2026 (okdiario).
findings.why_not_priced: Every award is press-released, so this is largely priced. The only upside is LOI-to-contract conversion and an intake upgrade in the release. The recent run-up partly reflects it.
findings.independence: Company news list (https://www.tecnicasreunidas.es/news/) and the Renta 4 note of 15 Sep 2026 ('la contratación del año supera los 7.000 mln eur').

findings.finding: The issuer's buy-back (Inside Information 15 Sep 2026) bought about 40-70k shares a day in early October, roughly a third of daily volume, and has filed no weekly execution report after the 8-14 Oct period, so a flow support may have ended before the print.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up since 26 Oct came without visible buy-back filings, so the price does not depend on that support. Inferred from absent filings, not from a stated end date, so sized near zero.
findings.independence: Company OIR list (https://www.tecnicasreunidas.es/cnmv-notification/other-relevant-information/): the last buy-back item is dated 15 Oct 2026.

outside_window.finding: Conversion of the USD 1.65bn Middle East onshore gas LOI into a signed contract, and the Bapco Sitra arbitration or amicable settlement. Neither is dated inside the window.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative (a sales-guide risk) against a +20% 20-day run-up that has already priced optimism. They cut against the run-up's direction but agree with its free-control sign (-run_up is the negative lean), so they add little over the benchmark beyond the guidance mechanism.
language_note: Renta 4's Spanish note (15 Sep) carried the quantified sales gap (2026e EUR 6,297m, 5% under the guide) and Q2 sales growth of +2.9%, which no English source surfaced

Bolsamania's Spanish report of the chairman's interview (22 Sep) carried the no-new-provisions-in-2026 statement, the 30% payout and the end-2026 first dividend payment; English search returned none of it
The issuer's OIR mirror (English versions of the Spanish CNMV filings) carried the Bapco/MGT cash impact and the buy-back reports; the language was not what made the difference there
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes median 9% against 2.3%): the sales-guide finding is sized on the guidance scale, -1.0 to -1.5 with a wider range

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the no-provision statement was folded into the dividend/capital_return finding rather than filed on its own, so the count went from 6 to 5 (the draft's +0.3 no-provision and +0.3 dividend became one +0.3)
'Size the move on what is new' (numbers new, guidance line live, size understated by a factor of three): abs_move_pct went from 6.0 to 7.0
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': kept the net-cash finding at -0.3 rather than dropping it as pre-flagged
Buy-back flow finding moved from +0.1 to -0.1: on re-reading, the evidence (reports stopped) argues for support ending, not continuing; p_up 47 -> 46
